g.title: video_processor
g.text: u_pipe (video_pipeline) and the serializers; the full top level, with py_soc and vision_system, is in system_block_diagram.svg
Bold = library IP module name, grey = instance name. Every ISP stage and the scaler can be bypassed (BYPASS register, 0x008). Interfaces tagged `VP_* are included / excluded in src/configuration.sv.
